name: SPACE MARINES: PRIMARIS REPULSOR EXECUTIONER
description: The Repulsor Executioner sacrifices transport space for additional capacitors, plasma cells, and ballistic cogitators. Even the largest battle tanks can be crippled by the beam of a heavy laser destroyer, while the incinerating blasts of a macro plasma incinerator can obliterate entire infantry formations.This multipart plastic kit builds one Repulsor Executioner, a heavily armed battle tank for your Space Marine armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Choose from two powerful primary turret-mounted weapons – the tank-busting heavy laser destroyer, or the macro plasma incinerator, which can melt through even the toughest infantry armour. Added to this is a coaxial heavy onslaught gatling cannon and a hull-mounted twin heavy bolter to thin out enemy hordes, plus defensive weapons including storm bolters, grenade launchers, and a twin Icarus ironhail heavy stubber. There's very little in the galaxy that can survive such concentrated firepower, and the Repulsor Executioner can even transport a small unit into the heat of battle at the same time.The kit also includes an optional gunner, who can be built scanning with an auspex or with his hands on the trigger of the pintle-mounted ironhail heavy stubber. There is also an optional ironhail heavy stubber and Icarus rocket pod to provide more anti-aircraft firepower. There are eight pieces of optional stowage and two antennae that can be used to further decorate the vehicle.This kit comprises 150 plastic components, 1x Citadel 100mm Round Base, and 1x clear hover stand, which can be set at an angle to add a certain degree of camber to your miniature. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
